evidence_notes: A benchmark of LLM agents reading, patching and writing weights is the whole paper (p.1-4). Agents work through Claude Code/Codex in a CPU sandbox with metered forward passes and some zero-pass tasks (p.2, p.4-5), so code_or_tensor_tool and both protocols; targets range from 2K MLPs to 7B transformers (p.4). '42 registered tasks' refers to the task registry, not a preregistration (p.4); DeepSeek scored 0.000 on WRITE vs Opus 0.829 (Table 1, p.5); Claude models had two samples per task, others one (p.5); code at github.com/Aayush-Marasini/WeightBench (p.1).
